answer: Sybils must acquire and burn fresh opal per fake agent plus forfeit the jade stake on any challenge, while honest peers recover their velvet reputation multiplier. Agents stake a jade-bonded deposit locked for a full epoch before voting; each identity also burns a unique opal token minted once per human-verified key, making duplicate identities costly. Attack cost scales linearly with fake identities, so swarming the registry becomes economically irrational. From qwe0004's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
